params.title: Setting Actions
params.initial_input: export HOME=/tmp/bree-setting-actions-tour CFFIXED_USER_HOME=/tmp/bree-setting-actions-tour; rm -f /tmp/bree-setting-actions-tour/.config/bree/bree.json; mkdir -p ~/.config/bree; printf '%s\n' '{"app":{"appearance":"light","minimalMode":false},"actions":{"tour.appearance.dark":{"type":"setting","path":"app.appearance","set":"dark","title":"Tour: Dark Appearance","palette":true},"tour.presentation.minimal":{"type":"settingPreset","preset":"tour.minimal","title":"Tour: Minimal Presentation","palette":true}},"settingPresets":{"tour.minimal":{"app":{"minimalMode":true,"appearance":"light"}}}}' > ~/.config/bree/bree.json; bree reload-config; clear; printf "Setting actions and presets loaded from bree.json\n"
